annotations.title: Add earlier plays to my account

description: Attaches plays made earlier without an account to the signed-in player's Plot Speaks account, so they appear in their history (with how each ended) and in the "not played yet" filter, and marks the trivia clues already heard in those games. Returns a sentence naming the titles added and how many could not be added (id not found, or already on another account). Without a signed-in account it returns an error saying so. Changes the account's history; plays on another account are left alone.

play_ids.description: 1 to 50 play ids, as returned by start_story, e.g. ["3f2b8c1e-9d4a-4e7b-a1c2-5b6d7e8f9a0b"]; ids of plays made in this conversation without an account
